claim: The Regulation establishes the Social Climate Fund for 2026–2032 to support measures and investments in Member State Social Climate Plans
inferential_step: Restatement of the expressed subject matter and objectives

claim: Member States must prepare and submit coherent Plans with specified measures investments milestones targets consultation and control arrangements
property_bearer: Member State Plan duty under Regulation 2023/955
inferential_step: Multiple duties grouped by shared plan-preparation function
boundary: No claims about actual consultation or plan quality

claim: The Commission assesses Plans against statutory criteria and adopts the decision that determines whether and on what terms the allocation is made
property_bearer: Plan assessment/approval relationship in Fund design
inferential_step: Commission assessment and implementing-act decision form a consequential sequential relationship

claim: Fund implementation is assigned to the Commission under direct management while Member States implement their approved Plans
inferential_step: Read direct-management clause with distinct national implementation/control duties
boundary: Direct management does not mean Commission executes each measure

claim: Payment to a Member State is conditioned on satisfactory achievement of agreed milestones and targets and is subject to suspension reduction or termination rules
inferential_step: Connected payment sequence creates a legally consequential performance condition
boundary: No evidence of actual payment or performance

claim: Member States must operate controls and provide declarations audit summaries records and access supporting protection of EU financial interests
inferential_step: Control duties are linked to payment agreements and oversight access

claim: The Commission and EU oversight bodies have specified audit/control access while the Commission may reduce support or recover funds for specified breaches
inferential_step: Access powers and remedial consequences support accountability characterization
boundary: OLAF/Court of Auditors/EPPO roles differ; not Fund managers

claim: Member States must consult specified stakeholders and summarize how input is reflected in Plans
inferential_step: Consultation plus required account of input constitutes a plan-development relationship
boundary: No inference of influence or representativeness

claim: Member States may route support through public or private entities subject to safeguards ensuring full benefit pass-through
inferential_step: Conditional permission and pass-through safeguard create a channeling relationship

claim: Member States report implementation biennially and the Commission monitors implementation and evaluates the Fund
inferential_step: Reporting duties plus a designated receiving/monitoring actor and evaluation function

claim: Plan preparation consultation and Commission assessment/approval form a plan-governance configuration around selection and authorization of Fund-supported measures
inferential_step: Multiple linked submission consultation assessment and decision relations organize one stage
boundary: Bounded to the Fund Plan cycle

claim: Direct-managed milestone-conditioned financing forms a performance-linked funding configuration
inferential_step: Direct management plus agreement payment assessment and remedial sequence jointly organize disbursement

claim: National implementation under financial control audit data and remedial arrangements forms an accountability/control configuration
inferential_step: Control duties access reporting assessment transparency and consequences form a linked governance stage
boundary: Some forums are distinct and not every tool applies in every case

claim: The Regulation constitutes a Commission-managed national-plan-mediated performance-conditioned and control-intensive public funding architecture with vertically distributed implementation
property_bearer: Fund-specific formal legal design in Regulation 2023/955
evidence_anchors: Claims C03–C07 C10–C13; Arts. 1–27; Annex III
inferential_step: Aggregation of three stage-linked configurations; consequential Commission approval/payment gates coexist with national implementation duties and controls
boundary: Not a claim about the whole climate/social regime or implementation

claim: deferred: the broader climate/social regulatory regime and its relations to other regimes are not inferred from this single instrument
inferential_step: Regime boundary requires evidence across additional instruments and institutions
